title: Agent-Native 3D Scene Studio — A Little World, Built Together
status: Production script; final capture and upload remain separate verification steps.
capture_note: The final edit combines multiple real native WebMCP sessions. Show 'Edited demo · multiple live WebMCP sessions' at the opening and on evidence cards. Label cuts that remove agent waiting time and preserve continuously moving scene footage under narration.

segments.title: A little world
segments.narration: A quiet cabin, warm lanterns, soft music. A little world to unwind in — built together with a browser agent.
segments.visual: Open on a moving moonlit cabin beauty shot. Show the project title briefly, then the real browser-agent prompt.
segments.tts_narration: A quiet cabin, warm lanterns, soft music. A little world to unwind in — built together with a browser agent.

segments.title: Ask the browser agent
segments.narration: I ask my agent for an endless moonlit retreat. Through WebMCP, it discovers the studio's tools and chooses the scene, mood, build pace, camera, and music.
segments.visual: Show native discovery and compose_lofi_scene with scene lakeside_cabin, mood moonlit, build_seconds 20, seed 42, cycle true, hold_seconds 180, camera cinematic and music true. Keep the genuine result readable.
segments.tts_narration: I ask my agent for an endless moonlit retreat. Through Web M C P, it discovers the studio's tools and chooses the scene, mood, build pace, camera, and music.

segments.title: Watch it unfold
segments.narration: Water appears. A cabin arrives. Pines grow, and lanterns glow. These are live, editable three-dimensional objects. The camera drifts while my own lofi music plays.
segments.visual: Play the real gradual pond, cabin, forest and lantern build without speed changes. Show actual audio playback or the sound-unlock click. Finish with a continuous moving camera shot.
segments.tts_narration: Water appears. A cabin arrives. Pines grow, and lanterns glow. These are live, editable three-dimensional objects. The camera drifts while my own lofi music plays.

segments.title: An observable session
segments.narration: The agent gets a session ID straight away. It can read build progress, the next scene, camera motion, and real audio playback — while the world keeps moving.
segments.visual: Show the real describe_scene result alongside the visible scene and sequence progress. Keep scene, sequence, camera_motion and music state readable.
segments.tts_narration: The agent gets a session ID straight away. It can read build progress, the next scene, camera motion, and real audio playback — while the world keeps moving.

segments.title: Let the scene change
segments.narration: Now I ask for the next scene. One WebMCP call starts a gentle transition, and a new world grows. Lakeside Cabin, Lantern Grove, and Island Hideaway can keep cycling, with time to linger in each.
segments.visual: Show a genuine control_lofi call with action next. Record the transition and the next recipe's build. Use the initial 20-second build setting and allow the resulting construction to remain visible.
segments.tts_narration: Now I ask for the next scene. One Web M C P call starts a gentle transition, and a new world grows. Lakeside Cabin, Lantern Grove, and Island Hideaway can keep cycling, with time to linger in each.

segments.title: Stay a little longer
segments.narration: The agent can change the pace, advance the scene, or pause and stop. When it stops, every built object stays here, ready to edit.
segments.visual: Show the named scene, next-scene countdown and continuous camera. Briefly reveal the editable objects and tool activity without suggesting arbitrary text-to-mesh generation.
segments.tts_narration: The agent can change the pace, advance the scene, or pause and stop. When it stops, every built object stays here, ready to edit.

segments.title: The human keeps control
segments.narration: I still have the mouse. Grabbing the canvas pauses the whole sequence. I can explore, resume when I'm ready, or undo the session.
segments.visual: Show a manual canvas drag, paused full-session state and a real resume. If showing undo, preserve its actual response and return to a previously captured live beauty shot with an explicit cut.
segments.tts_narration: I still have the mouse. Grabbing the canvas pauses the whole sequence. I can explore, resume when I'm ready, or undo the session.

segments.title: Built together
segments.narration: TypeScript, three.js, and twenty-six WebMCP tools. Real scene state, beyond the pixels. No app login — just shared creative control, and a little world to slow down in.
segments.visual: Show the real registration source briefly, then finish on a moving clean scene with the project title and https://agent-native-3d-studio.netlify.app.
